description:
List the cloudPC devices in a tenant.

TIP: Lists Cloud PCs (Windows 365) provisioned in the tenant. Each has displayName, managedDeviceName, userPrincipalName, status (provisioned, provisioning, failed, notProvisioned), provisioningPolicyId, imageDisplayName, lastModifiedDateTime, gracePeriodEndDateTime, and aadDeviceId. Use $filter=status eq 'provisioned' or status eq 'failed'. Use $top to limit.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-cloud-pcs
